title: WCW’s farewell: one last Flair–Sting match
summary: WCW’s sale gives its last Nitro the character of a farewell. Flair and Sting revisit the rivalry that defined multiple eras, while the McMahon television story begins a separate WWE chapter.

chapters.title: The acquisition is announced
chapters.result: WWF announces its acquisition of WCW assets.
chapters.context: This is the real business transaction. Shane McMahon’s later claim of ownership is a television storyline.

chapters.title: Sting and Flair close the wrestling card
chapters.result: Sting defeats Flair in Nitro’s final match.
chapters.context: The old rivals embrace after the bout. WCW’s own timeline ends here; the later Invasion is indexed under WWE.
